gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-noticia-text: Literary and dignified, Noticia Text lets each curve swing in through a visible entrance. Baloo Thambi 2 is the loud one, with its deep-bellied lowercase, while the text serif keeps its large letter bodies quietly steady.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-piazzolla: Baloo Thambi 2 has a deep-bellied lowercase and distinct gaps in its c, e and s that make it instantly recognizable. Piazzolla counters with a refined text serif whose small letters nearly match its capitals, so it does the quiet authority.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-pridi: Round, bold and full of character, Baloo Thambi 2 sits over a text serif that feels refined. Pridi gives it generous space where curves meet the stem, and its small letters stand almost capital-sized.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-scope-one:
Baloo Thambi 2 has a deep midsection in its lowercase.

Scope One follows with a classic serif body: spilling counters and a big x-height, stubby ascenders, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-slabo-13px: Bookish and dignified, Slabo 13px opens its tall a, e and s into large counters. Baloo Thambi 2 brings expressive depth up top, and the text serif keeps every rounded letter clearly open down the page.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-crimson-pro: Stencil-cut steadiness leads here, since Balsamiq Sans draws a monoline line with no pinched curves. Crimson Pro brings a restrained thick-thin cadence like a worn wooden stamp, and its classic serif letters pack close together.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-recia:
Recia is a text serif with sharp authority.

Balsamiq Sans hangs above it with bold curves that never thin at the shoulders, while Recia keeps a soft brushed modulation and openings that stay generous at every weight.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-andada-pro: Bold, stencil-steady lines carry Balsamiq Sans, with curves that never thin out. Andada Pro is a classic serif whose stems run a touch heavier than its crossbars, and its counters let the eye slip in.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-aref-ruqaa-ink: Lightly modulated and open throughout, Aref Ruqaa Ink reads like a classic serif with literary ease and no harsh thin spots. Balsamiq Sans stays bold above it.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-average: Authoritative and literary, Average gives its e a gaping mouth and curves with a reed pen's slight thickening. But Balsamiq Sans keeps its monoline line steady above, so a classic serif paragraph reads with a gentle, pen-drawn pulse.
